description:
List fund categories

The categories TEFAS uses per fund type — umbrella fund types for investment funds, fund kinds for pension funds and ETFs — in English and Turkish, with how many active funds each has. Free.

GET /v1/funds/categories on Turkish funds (SBX-FON). Costs 0 credits per call.
